title: execution.trade-plan.v1
description: SKELETON, not yet wired into any service (docs/adr/007-shared-cross-service-contracts.md). Target Kafka replacement for today's real, live contract: contracts/autotrade/trade-plan-v8.json (TradePlan V8, Redis-transported, built by algo-bot's app/autotrade/trade_plan_builder.py, parsed/executed by ctrader-engine's TradePlanRuntime.cs — that fixture set is NOT superseded by this file yet; it remains the operative contract until Kafka cutover, per ADR-004/ADR-007). Field shape below is a deliberately thinned skeleton of the real V8 plan shape (analysis/source_structure/entry/stop/targets), not a field-for-field copy — the real contract has ~20+ fields per section (target ladders, scale-in legs, opposing-zone context, risk multiplier) that belong in a full port, not an architecture-task skeleton.

opportunity_id.description: Traces back to the analysis.opportunity.v1 event this plan was built from — analysis-engine never builds a TradePlan itself (docs/architecture/algo-bot.md's TradePlan-ownership section).

price.description: Decimal-as-string, matching V8's own convention (avoids float round-tripping across languages).
